charm.how: Catch all 150 original Pokémon (No. 001–150), then talk to the Game Freak director in Celadon City.
charm.note: Pokémon.com Let's Go post-game guide; Serebii

methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 4,096 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try per Pokémon, 3 with the Shiny Charm. Legendaries, Snorlax and other static Pokémon count here: the Shiny Charm helps them, a catch combo doesn't.
methods.note: Base odds; statics take the charm but not the combo (Serebii, RotomLabs)

methods.name: Lure
methods.plain: Use a Lure: one extra shiny try for every wild Pokémon while it lasts.
methods.detail: +1 try. Stacks with the catch combo and the Shiny Charm.

methods.name: Catch combo
methods.plain: Catch the same Pokémon again and again without running away: after 31 in a row, about 1 in 342 is shiny (1 in 293 with the Shiny Charm).
methods.detail: Combo 0–10: 1 try, 11–20: 4, 21–30: 8, 31+: 12; the Shiny Charm adds 2.

methods.name: Catch combo with a Lure
methods.plain: A catch combo with a Lure on and the Shiny Charm is the best way: about 1 in 273 from 31 in a row.
methods.detail: The combo's tries plus 1 for the Lure, plus 2 for the Shiny Charm.

methods.name: Gifts and in-game trades
methods.plain: Gifts and in-game trades can be shiny at the base 1 in 4,096; the Shiny Charm doesn't help.
